comments.value: As you mention, @{5c87baa8e6d1a57be67871ec|full_name}, this is all possible already with an Editor script. Load asset > split string > fill VRCUrl array.

details:
When i am trying use Textasset file (it's just text file) with a lot video links inside, i found out it's set as String.
I discovered and now i understand there is protection built inside Udon(Sharp) where String cannot used in videoplayer or in pictures (when VRC_Panorama alternative is ready) so i am searching for solutions.

I need find a way to make it Url variable, but Udon has nothing for String conversion. There is no String to VRCUrl, but there is VRCUrl to String conversion (kinda weird). The protection is meant to avoid changing urls in runtime (in world) and send data to servers - with IP and UserID for example. That is why String is blocked. But Url works like String... so how about this?

The VRCUrl can only added in Unity in fixed Urlinputfields but i saw you can make arrays with like VRCUrl[] or VRCUrl[][]. Arrays are allowed, but manual work to add so many urls in Unity Inspector is really frustrating work. Really waste of hours work. Why can it not bit automated?

There is with InspectorGUI conversion possible with UnityEditor, but i saw it's pretty hard and not easy to understand for people who just started to learn in Udon. Even i am more in coding, it's still hard and also it's pretty dirty way for me...

The good thing about Textasset is they are read-only, because Udon cannot change Text files. So i am thinking, why not add new function TextassetUrl to Udon? It's still safe and it's way much easier to code in Udon(Sharp) because it is directly converted in Url variable (similar like String).
Then it's easy task to split it in arrays, and then we can send it to videoplayer.
But due security part, there might some rules:
- You can use + in VRCUrl, but not with String values. It stays purely in VRCUrl. Like Filename = Serverurl + filename. Serverurl is also fixed value in Udon as VRCUrl value. Count up is not possible because Int to VRCUrl is not possible. You can still add numbers but only as fixed VRCUrl value. (But it's also possible to not allow + for VRCUrl if you dont want add too much. - means all links in Textasset must full links.)
- It's not possible change or convert dynamically in VRCUrl value, because there are no Url functions.
- The only allowed function for VRCUrl is Split function to make arrays possible (and still safe because it don't add new things)
- I guess the Split(value) may used as String or Char, because the risk is very low because it cannot add new things.
- Alternative you can add SplitUrl(value) if you want make it purely for VRCUrl, where value must in VRCUrl value. If you just make sure nothing will changed. You can set VRCUrl value like private VRCUrl splitValue = "\n" and it should stay safe.

If you add new functions like TextassetUrl, i am sure many people will happy it makes way much easier to make video listings and picture listings. With Text file, it is very easy to make listings (they can made from Excel CSV export for example) and text files are packed inside World package when uploaded to the server. There is no risk something will changed in runtime. It's all fixed anyway.
BTW it's in the end identical like VRCUrl[] or VRCUrl[][] after splitting text file. (reading with TextassetUrl.Text is directly in VRCUrl variable) So there are no differences because the outcome is same.

Without this function, it's really hard to program correctly and it's also not inside Udon possible, because Textasset output is unsafe String, and that is not possible for videoplayers and VRC_Panorama (image) loading. Please make this possible. I dont like kinda dirty work with #if !COMPILER_UDONSHARP && UNITY_EDITOR function. Make it in Udon and it's much easier and much shorter code. And it looks also more clean.
title: Make TextAssetUrl possible.
